story.text: The {CHESHIRE} {CAT} is sitting on a bough of a tree. “Would you tell me, please, which way I ought to go from here?” asks Alice. That depends on where she wants to get to. The {HATTER} lives one way, the March {HARE} the other: “they’re both {MAD}. We’re all mad here.” Then it {VANISHES} quite slowly, beginning with the end of the {TAIL}, and ending with the {GRIN}, which remains some time after the rest of it has gone.
story.caption: A grin without a cat
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
